title: GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions
abstract: arXiv:2609.34113v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding where and why Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents fail is essential for building more reliable systems, yet current evaluation relies on step accuracy, a metric that treats each screen independently and overlooks the underlying structure of GUI environments. This leads to two critical blind spots: (1) functionally equivalent screens are evaluated in isolation, obscuring systematic failure patterns across shared screens; and (2) the long-tailed GUI distribution renders failures on rare but critical screens invisible under standard metrics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{GUITAR}, a state-centric diagnostic framework that performs structured failure analysis over both states and transitions, using a State Transition Graph (STG) by mapping visually diverse screens to shared functional states. translated_title: GUITAR：基于状态转换的GUI智能体结构化故障诊断框架
translated_abstract: 理解图形用户界面（GUI）智能体在何处以及为何失败，对于构建更可靠的系统至关重要，然而当前的评估依赖于“逐步准确率”这一指标，该指标将每个屏幕独立对待，忽视了GUI环境的底层结构。这导致了两个关键的盲点：（1）功能等价的屏幕被孤立评估，掩盖了跨共享屏幕的系统性失败模式；（2）GUI分布的长尾特性使得罕见但关键屏幕上的失败在标准指标下变得不可见。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了GUITAR——一个以状态为中心的诊断框架，它通过将视觉上多样的屏幕映射到共享的功能状态，利用状态转换图（STG）对状态和转换进行结构化的失败分析。在来自AndroidControl和Mind2Web的8个智能体和6个任务上，GUITAR揭示了60.4%的失败发生在20%的（少数状态中）。
tldr: GUITAR提出了一种基于状态转换图（STG）的结构化诊断框架，将视觉多样的屏幕映射到共享功能状态来分析GUI智能体的失败模式，发现60.4%的失败集中在20%的少数状态中，从而克服了传统逐步准确率指标的盲点。
en_tdlr: GUITAR is a state-centric diagnostic framework that uses State Transition Graphs to map visually diverse screens to shared functional states, revealing that 60.4% of GUI agent failures concentrate in just 20% of states—overcoming the blind spots of step-accuracy-based evaluation.
